answer_1.quote: Web query generation is essential for search engines . The task of web query generation is to make the generated queries align with users' personal preferences...

answer_3.quote: We evaluate using: (1) Relevance rate: alignment scores between generated queries and user history via LLaMA 3 (70B)... and (2) Win-Tie-Lose rates: pairwise comparisons between models using LLaMA 3 (70B) voting.
